_comment: Rival stores, phase 1 (issue #129; user decisions 2026-10-27: they open on map sites, take most right after opening and settle down, run sales now and then, not in the first days and can be switched off). A rival opens on the free site nearest to the company's first store from first_day, then every interval_days, at most max_rivals. Share it takes from a store: (floor + (peak - floor) x exp(-days open / settle_days) + sale_bonus while on sale) x max(0, 1 - distance / reach_share of the map width); all rivals together at most total_cap. No random draws. Fictional chains only. Initial values, to be tuned by play.
_comment_phase3: Phase 3: a rival renovates once, renovate_after_days after it opened: it is shut for renovate_days and reopens with the opening pull again. A rival open at least close_min_days closes for good on a day the company's first store has a reputation of close_reputation or more; its site is free again. No random draws.
